messages:
Maya Chen: quick morning handoff — Aj is primary for the 08:00-16:00 UTC shift, Samir is secondary. I'm around until 09:30 in case of questions.

Maya Chen: heads-up: we have an active alert from the incident bot for svc-inference: increased 95th latency for text-generation (US-W). Looks like customer-facing error rate is still low but latency breaches SLO. tagging it as P2 for now, will escalate if error rate rises.

OpsBot: [INC-2026-0314-89] svc-inference latency > 95th for 5m. Hosts: gpu-pool-3a. Linked runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/inference-latency.

Aj Patel: taking this. thanks @Maya. checking dashboards and recent deploys.

Aj Patel: quick check: no deploys in last 2 hours. rolling back not needed. looking at queue depth and batching metrics.

Samir Rao: if queue depth > 2500 we should temporarily tighten batching window per runbook. also keep an eye on KV cache warming.

Aj Patel: confirmed queue depth ~ 2700 on gpu-pool-3a. latency correlated with batch size spikes. I'm going to reduce batching target from 256 -> 128 for pool-3a via runtime flag. will do a canary first.

Tess Li: pinging customer success to let high-traffic customers know we're investigating. No outage yet, but they might see slow responses.

Aj Patel: applying config change for pool-3a now (canary). command: ```redwoodctl runtime update --pool gpu-pool-3a --batched_tokens 128 --canary 10%```

OpsBot: config update initiated by Aj Patel. Canary 10% applied to gpu-pool-3a-canary-1. Monitoring 60s.

Aj Patel: canary looks good — 95th latency down ~18% on canary nodes. rolling to 50% now.

Samir Rao: when we roll to production, follow the escalation checklist in the runbook: page PG-leads if mitigation fails or error rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m. Also note: if CPU on proxies rises >85% during rollout, stop and revert.

Maya Chen: agree. escalation rules reminder (short):
- page primary on-call (first pager) for P2 during mitigation: @Aj (already on).
- escalate to secondary after 10m if unresolved: @Samir.
- page on-call manager / PG-leads for P1 or customer-impacting >5% errors: @tess (CS lead) + @ops-manager.

Maya Chen: paste of minimal pager matrix (for quick copy):
```
P1: page on-call + ops-manager + PG-leads (phone + slack)
P2 unresolved >10m: page secondary on-call -> then ops-manager if no progress
P3: slack thread ok, no pager unless customer escalates
```

Tess Li: CS notified major customers with a short advisory. no escalations from them yet.

Aj Patel: rolling to 100% now. monitoring global 95th and error rate.

OpsBot: update: 95th latency decreased to within SLO on gpu-pool-3a. Monitoring for 15 more minutes.

Samir Rao: nice work. note for next handoff: add a pointer to the batch-sizing defaults in runtime-configs doc so the next oncall can tune faster.

Maya Chen: done — added a short note in the handoff doc (https://internal.redwood/handoffs/2026-03-14) and set a quick postmortem todo (no customer impact, just ops tuning).

Maya Chen: ending handoff — Aj remains primary until 16:00 UTC. Samir you are the escalation backup. if anything resurfaces please page as per matrix above. :thumbsup:

Aj Patel: will monitor. thanks everyone.

OpsBot: [INC-2026-0314-89] status: mitigated (canary -> pool rollout). Incident will be auto-resolved in 30m if no regressions.
